name: Miransertib
sort_evidence: The only active trial, NCT04980872 (MK-7075-006), is a rollover safety study for PROS and Proteus patients already on miransertib; no discontinuation statement was found and no book row holds it.

trials.title: A Study of the Safety and Tolerability in Participants With PIK3CA-related Overgrowth Spectrum or Proteus Syndrome Who Are Being Treated With Miransertib (MK-7075) in Other Studies (MK-7075-006)
